TestSimpleDriver::test_simple_create_ins.description: 2015 smoke test: boots a 1-node cluster with --smp 1 or --smp 2 (autouse fixture params SMP=1/SMP=2), creates ks RF=1 and table (k int PRIMARY KEY, c int), inserts one row and checks SELECT k=1 returns 1 row and k=2 returns 0 rows. Only row counts asserted, not values. No specific bug guarded; general boot+CQL sanity, part of next_gating.

TestSimpleDriver::test_simple_composite_.description: Single-node (SMP=1/2) table with composite partition key PRIMARY KEY ((k1,k2)); inserts (1,1) and (1,2), asserts SELECT on each full key returns 1 row and on missing keys (2,1),(1,3) returns 0 rows. Only row counts asserted. Generic CQL sanity, no bug guarded.
